mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or CPI YoY growth > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or GDPC1 decline does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in one month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or INDPRO decline > 2% does not correlate with subsequent supply chain issues.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances despite positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease does not correlate with subsequent easing actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales (RSAFS) combined with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong consumer demand and economic health, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or the joint increase in RSAFS and decrease in UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent economic strength.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs in one month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or PAYEMS increase > 200,000 does not correlate with subsequent labor market strength.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over two consecutive months signals a strengthening housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or HOUST increase does not correlate with subsequent housing market strength.
